releaseNotes:
• Fixed Single-App & Game capture across OEM devices (Xiaomi, Realme, Vivo, Samsung)
• Eliminated false-alarm 'Be Right Back' pause freezes caused by floating Game Turbo overlays
• Continuous under-speech fan noise subtraction & air-band de-hissing in live mic DSP
• Internal game audio continuity with automatic stereo capture fallback and bitwise downmixing
• Auto-fallback to Entire Screen on Android 10–13 devices
